title.narrative: Stimulating industrial competitiveness through biomass-based, grid-connected electricity generation

description.narrative: The project aims to promote the implementation of decentralized, biomass-based energy production in industrial free zones in the Dom inican Republic with the aim of reducing GHG emissions, while contributing to their competitiveness. This project was requested through the GEF operational focal point at the Ministry of Environment and Natural Resources of the Dominican Republic as part of the government of the Dominican Republic's efforts to mitigate climate change..
